numerical_failure.observed_behavior: raises ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero when called with an empty pvals array because corrected alphas are computed from 1/ntests before checking method-specific branches
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: should not divide by zero for empty pvals; per-method branches should run on the empty array yielding empty results, and corrected alphas should be reported as nan (undefined without any tests)
trigger_conditions: pvals is an empty array (so ntests == 0)
calling multipletests([]) regardless of method (including fdr_* methods that delegate to fdrcorrection)

input_output_examples.expected_output: (empty results) with corrected alphas reported as nan (alphacSidak = np.nan, alphacBonf = np.nan)

oracle_clues: multipletests computes alphacSidak and alphacBonf using 1.0/ntests and alphaf/float(ntests) before method dispatch, so ntests==0 triggers float division by zero
the fix introduces an if ntests > 0 else block: in the empty case alphacSidak = np.nan and alphacBonf = np.nan, and per-method branches should operate on the empty array yielding empty results

category_specific_evidence: multipletests computes Sidak and Bonferroni corrected alphas as 1 - (1 - alphaf)^(1/ntests) and alphaf/float(ntests), respectively—i.e., it divides by ntests; when pvals is empty, ntests = len(pvals) = 0 and this triggers a bare “float division by zero” (ZeroDivisionError).
CONTEXT reproducer shows the failing computations: ntests = len(pvals); alphacSidak = 1 - np.power((1.0 - alphaf), 1.0 / ntests); alphacBonf = alphaf / float(ntests).

test_multipletests_empty asserts empty-input outputs (reject.shape == (0,), pvals_corrected.shape == (0,)) and asserts corrected alphas are undefined: np.isnan(alphac_sidak) and np.isnan(alphac_bonf).

The fix adds an if ntests > 0 / else ntests==0 block setting alphacSidak = np.nan and alphacBonf = np.nan so the division-by-zero computation is skipped and per-method branches operate on the empty array. (No dtype/precision/tolerance details are provided.)
reproduction_risks: dtype is not mentioned in the provided passages; evidence does not state whether the discrepancy depends on float32 vs float64 or other dtypes.
precision is not mentioned in the provided passages; no precision/rounding sensitivity or ULP behavior is described.
magnitude regime is not described beyond the discrete regime ntests == 0 (empty pvals). No other magnitude range is stated.
tolerance/threshold for separating correct vs incorrect numerical answers is not provided; the only numerical assertions are that alphac_sidak and alphac_bonf are NaN for empty input.
